import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import umap
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate high-dimensional dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=300, n_features=20, n_classes=4, random_state=42)

# Apply UMAP to reduce to 2 dimensions
reducer = umap.UMAP(n_components=2, random_state=42)
X_umap = reducer.fit_transform(X)

# Create a dataframe with UMAP components and labels
df_umap = pd.DataFrame({
    'umap_x': X_umap[:, 0],
    'umap_y': X_umap[:, 1],
    'label': y
})

# Print the embedding results
print(f"UMAP result shape: {df_umap.shape}")
print("\nUMAP Embedding (first 10 rows):")
print(df_umap.head(10))
print("\nClass distribution:")
print(df_umap['label'].value_counts().sort_index())
